features.name: lsat_z_score
features.description: Standardized LSAT score centered on training mean and scaled by training std, useful as a linear projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth normalized continuous input ideal for SVM margin computation.

features.name: decile_avg
features.description: Average of the two decile rankings, providing a smoother academic standing measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces noise in decile signals and produces a single linear-friendly academic ranking.

features.name: decile_progression
features.description: Change between later and earlier decile rankings indicating academic trajectory.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures linear directional signal about improvement or decline in standing.

features.name: lsat_per_decile
features.description: Ratio of LSAT score to mean decile ranking capturing efficiency of test performance vs class rank.
features.expected_model_benefit: Composite ratio yields a stable linear discriminator.

features.name: academic_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of standardized LSAT, decile, and undergraduate GPA representing overall academic strength.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aligns multiple correlated academic indicators into a single linear-margin-friendly axis.

features.name: fam_inc_normalized
features.description: Family income scaled to [0,1] range for smooth socioeconomic signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded normalized feature suitable for linear SVM weighting.

features.name: age_centered
features.description: Age centered on training mean and scaled by std for smooth deviation measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides centered numeric input avoiding scale dominance in linear models.

features.name: ugpa_lsat_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between standardized GPA and LSAT capturing joint academic strength.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a nonlinear interaction term as a linear feature improving SVM separability.

features.name: fulltime_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator of full-time status (1 if fulltime category is 1).
features.expected_model_benefit: Clean binary signal directly usable in linear margin.

features.name: cluster_tier_score
features.description: Ordinal semantic ranking of school cluster tiers mapped to a smooth severity score where lower cluster numbers indicate different program tiers (1->0.8, 2->0.6, 3->0.5, 4->0.4, 5->0.3, 6->0.2).
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates categorical cluster into smooth ordered numeric feature for linear margin.

features.name: decile_consistency
features.description: Inverse absolute deviation between two deciles indicating consistency of academic performance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth bounded score rewarding stable academic profiles, helpful for linear separation.

features.name: demographic_advantage_judgment
features.description: Semantic composite reflecting demographic and socioeconomic context combining gender, race, and family income into a smooth normalized score representing structural opportunity context.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-formulaic interpretable demographic context as a linear feature aiding margin calibration.
